note: Raw demos and parsed pickles live only on this machine under data/. They are gitignored (size and HLTV demo redistribution). Re-fetch with the commands below.

corpora.title: Esports Trajectories and Actions
corpora.what: 1,558 professional demos already parsed to JSON (2 Hz frames, kills, damage, flashes, bomb). LAN 680 + online 878.
corpora.fetch: git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/pnxenopoulos/esta.git data/esta && poswing esta data/esta/data/lan -o data/cache/esta --workers 2 && poswing esta data/esta/data/online -o data/cache/esta --workers 2

corpora.title: HLTV CS2 demos (blanchon/cs2_dataset_demo)
corpora.license: Dataset card: CC BY 4.0. Demos are mirrors of HLTV public /download/demo/; tournament terms still apply. Not redistributed in git.
corpora.upstream_size: 1,988 maps, about 935 GB. This checkout is a slice, not the whole set.
corpora.selection: Per map: every regulation demo (16-36 rounds) with HLTV stars >= 3, plus the smallest regulation demos, in two batches (18 then 24 extra per map). Active-duty pool only: mirage, dust2, nuke, ancient, anubis, inferno, overpass. Parsed at 1 Hz with demoparser2 into MatchData.
not_downloaded: The other ~1,666 maps in blanchon/cs2_dataset_demo (~800 GB still on the Hub).
KEDevO/CounterQuant-CS2-Demos — listed on the Hub card, API returned 401 (private or removed).
sneakyzero/cs2-pro-round-economy — 22 MB of freeze-time economy only, no positions, so it cannot train the positional layer.
RekaAI/CS2-10k and Unit293/CQ-Avatar-Training — trajectories exist but as egocentric video clips or normalized single-player windows, not full 10-player round state.

usable_for_fit: poswing fit reads a directory of .pkl files. Keep ESTA (CS:GO places) and this CS2 slice separate unless place names are aligned. Mirage renames live in poswing.esta.PLACE_RENAMES; other maps are not renamed.
